name: cloudflare-pages
description: Publishes the site's static export to Cloudflare Pages with the workspace's own saved token and account ID. Ships the host code itself (Tovu loads it only because Tovu shipped it) and the know-how an agent needs: which token permission to create, where the account ID is, and what each failure means in plain words.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Puts your website online on Cloudflare Pages. The assistant shows you a preview first.
